offering_description.value: Provides fiber-based broadband internet, video and voice services to residential customers and businesses, and fiber transport and wholesale services to carriers. It builds and operates its own fiber network, mainly in Mid-Atlantic and Appalachian states.

primary_services.value: fiber broadband internet; video and voice; business data and Ethernet; wholesale fiber transport; tower leasing

customer_segment.value: B2C: Residential households subscribing to broadband, TV and voice; B2B: Small and mid-sized businesses, wireless carriers and other telecom carriers

revenue_model.value: subscription: monthly broadband, video and voice subscriptions; service fees: business data, Ethernet and carrier fiber transport services; rental or leasing: tower space and fiber leases to carriers
revenue_model.category: subscription; service fees; rental or leasing

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and operates fiber network built from purchased equipment, sells access to households, businesses and carriers; service provider: retail broadband and wholesale connectivity

geography_served.value: US regional: Virginia, West Virginia, Maryland, Pennsylvania, Ohio, Kentucky and nearby Mid-Atlantic states

specialization.value: related lines: fiber broadband, video/voice, enterprise and wholesale fiber services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams for business and carrier customers, door-to-door residential sales; online: web and phone sign-up for residential service

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Telecommunications services regulated by FCC and state utility commissions, franchise and broadband subsidy rules

notes: Offering is mainly services. Recent portfolio details (e.g., tower holdings) may have changed.
